tagline: 佳能取景器相机，1998 年发布
description: 佳能于1998年推出的取景器相机。配备Canon 35mm f/4.5, three element in 3 groups, when the camera in OFF position the lens cap closes automatically。快门速度Auto, Program-type electromagnetic shutter with aperture control, Speeds: 1/45, 1/100, 1/125 and 1/180。使用Auto, film is advanced to frame 1 automatically after being loaded and the back is closed。fixed-focus, range 1m to inf.。

specs.镜头: Canon 35mm f/4.5, three element in 3 groups, when the camera in OFF position the lens cap closes automatically
specs.快门: Auto, Program-type electromagnetic shutter with aperture control, Speeds: 1/45, 1/100, 1/125 and 1/180
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto, film is advanced to frame 1 automatically after being loaded and the back is closed
specs.闪光灯: range: ISO 100/200 1.5-3.5m, ISO 400 1.5-6.8m; Red-Eye Reduction feature; Fires automatically in low-light conditions
specs.电池: 2x AA Alkaline batteries, not compatible with Ni-Cd or Lithium batteries
specs.英文简介: Canon Prima BF8 (Date) is a 35mm compact, fully automatic, viewfinder film camera manufactured by Canon Camera Co., Inc, Tokyo, Japan and marketed in 1998.
